signature.name: VTask.write
signature.type: {Γ : Type u_1} -> {Λ : Type u_2} -> {σ : Type u_3} -> List Bool → Turing.TM1.Stmt Bool (Turing.TM1to1.Λ' Γ Λ σ) σ → Turing.TM1.Stmt Bool (Turing.TM1to1.Λ' Γ Λ σ) σ

conventions.statement: When the list `l` is `[]`, `VTask.write [] q` returns `q` unchanged, performing no writes or head movements.
conventions.note: Base case of the structural recursion; no junk value, a mathematically natural choice.

facts.statement: ∀ {Γ : Type} {Λ : Type} {σ : Type} (b : Bool) (q : Turing.TM1.Stmt Bool (Turing.TM1to1.Λ' Γ Λ σ) σ), VTask.write [b] q ≠ q

facts.statement: ∀ {Γ : Type} {Λ : Type} {σ : Type} [DecidableEq (Turing.TM1to1.Λ' Γ Λ σ)] (S : Finset (Turing.TM1to1.Λ' Γ Λ σ)) (l : List Bool) (q : Turing.TM1.Stmt Bool (Turing.TM1to1.Λ' Γ Λ σ) σ), Turing.TM1.SupportsStmt S (VTask.write l q) = Turing.TM1.SupportsStmt S q

facts.statement: ∀ {Γ : Type} {Λ : Type} {σ : Type} (b : Bool) (l : List Bool) (q : Turing.TM1.Stmt Bool (Turing.TM1to1.Λ' Γ Λ σ) σ), VTask.write (b :: l) q ≠ Turing.TM1.Stmt.halt

facts.statement: ∀ {Γ : Type} {Λ : Type} {σ : Type} (b1 b2 : Bool) (q : Turing.TM1.Stmt Bool (Turing.TM1to1.Λ' Γ Λ σ) σ), VTask.write [b1, b2] q ≠ VTask.write [b1] q

facts.statement: ∀ {Γ : Type} {Λ : Type} {σ : Type} [DecidableEq (Turing.TM1to1.Λ' Γ Λ σ)] (S : Finset (Turing.TM1to1.Λ' Γ Λ σ)) (l1 l2 : List Bool) (q : Turing.TM1.Stmt Bool (Turing.TM1to1.Λ' Γ Λ σ) σ), Turing.TM1.SupportsStmt S (VTask.write l1 q) = Turing.TM1.SupportsStmt S (VTask.write l2 q)
